reason: The hypothesis synthesizes the observation of local chemical fluctuations affecting SFE (P1) with the known effect of SFE on deformation mechanisms (P2, P30) to propose a deliberate engineering strategy—inducing controlled local chemical heterogeneities to tune SFE and deformation mode activation—which is not proposed or demonstrated in any single passage. It links these ideas through a mechanism of spatial SFE variation at defect sites, going beyond the literature's separate reports of local chemistry effects and global SFE tuning.
copied_elements: Local chemical fluctuations affect dislocation behavior and SFE (P1, P25)
Al and C additions increase SFE and suppress twinning (P2, P3, P5, P11)
SFE controls deformation mechanism activation (P2, P30, P32)
Lower SFE promotes twinning/TRIP and enhances work hardening (P8, P15, P30)
Local chemical order roughens dislocation pathways (P7, P27)
